+class TestSanitizeKeys(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_nested_keys_and_ignored_keys(self):
+        from collections import OrderedDict
+        original = [{'key-password': {'password': 1, '_ansible_password': 2, 'changed': 3}},

+        result = sanitize_keys(original, (b'password', 'changed'), frozenset(('changed',)))

+        self.assertEqual(result[1]['VALUE_SPECIFIED_IN_NO_LOG_PARAMETER'], 'password')
+        self.assertEqual(result[1]['changed'], 4)
+        self.assertEqual(original[0]['key-password']['password'], 1)
+
+    def test_non_mapping_values(self):

+    def test_immutable_mapping_and_tuple(self):
